title: The app slice of the screening evaluation and the L1 switch: the gateway-bff route name and path, the operation name of the rwb-source-data ledger read, the members the raise adds to the rwb-deviation request and answer, and the physical home of some columns are not fixed by any source
source: Legacy RWB-E2-029 sections 3, 4, 7, 11, 12 and 13; FSD P10 Agent runtime v3 A2.5 and A2.8; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T3.1, T3.2, T5.2 and T-A.1; API Specification v4 (/admin/agent-evaluations, /admin/agent-configs, /cases/{caseId}/agent-outputs, /agent-runs/{runId}/feedback, /cases/{caseId}/deviations, /deviations/{deviationId}); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 13, 15, 16, 41 and 43; Ownership Map v1 (eight agent tables owner P10, eleven P10 operations, seven P10 API rows, EV-28 owner P10, AgentRunWorkflow owner P10); Template and Rules v1 §R3, §R4, §R5.5, §R7.3 and §R9
section: 3 Preconditions; 5 Exception paths; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1, AC2, AC7, AC8; 10 Authority; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.2; 12.3; 12.8; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: Four values the app slice needs are absent or unresolved in the sources. (1) The gateway-bff route in front of the panel read, the feedback write and the evaluation reads has no name and no path; DP-19 requires the route and the legacy section 15 names only the screens. (2) The legacy story reads the complaint note and the preceding contact through an in-process ledger reader; in the target the ledger is P1 rwb-source-data, and no source names the operation or its query members, although DP-05 and DP-18 put the ledger there. (3) The legacy section 12 raises a deviation through a Java interface with raisedBy, documentIds and agentRunId and reads back a deviationId and a decisionLogEntryId; API Specification v4 gives DeviationRequest only deviationCode, reason and documentIds and the Deviation answer has no decisionLogEntryId, so the two members and the returned entry ID are stated by this story. (4) The legacy section 13 says no new table is needed; in the split the agent_feedback table and the panel and feedback operations belong to RWB-P10-E2028-APP, and the segment, floor, evaluation and promotion columns belong to RWB-P10-E1062-APP and RWB-P10-E2028-APP, because DP-15 is not a pattern of this key. The story keeps the legacy behaviour and settles each value as an assumption; no business value is invented.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E2-029 section 12 ('GET /api/recovery/v1/cases/{caseId}/agent-outputs (new, RWB-E2-028)', 'POST /api/recovery/v1/agent-runs/{runId}/feedback (new, RWB-E2-028)', the published interface 'DeviationRaised DeviationService.raise(UUID caseId, String deviationCode, String reason, List<UUID> documentIds, String raisedBy, UUID agentRunId); // returns deviationId and decisionLogEntryId') and section 13 ('Database: no new table; uses agent_feedback (RWB-E2-028) and agent_policy segment fields (RWB-E1-058)'); API Specification v4 DeviationRequest (deviationCode, reason, documentIds) and Deviation (id, caseId, deviationCode, raisedAt, raisedBy, pausedState, handlerUserId, contactStop, clearedAt) with no decisionLogEntryId; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T3.1 (agent_feedback DF-AGT-097 to DF-AGT-102, agent_evaluation DF-AGT-086 to DF-AGT-096) and T5.2 ('P3 for the case, P7 for the decision log, P4 for access and reference data, P5 for documents, P6 for notices'); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 15 (rwb-deviation IN: GET/POST /deviations; OUT: rwb.deviation.events.v1) and slide 16 (P10 IN and OUT); Ownership Map v1 (deviation owner S8, interaction owner P1, seven P10 API rows, eight agent tables); Template and Rules v1 §R5.5 DP-03, DP-05, DP-06, DP-07, DP-11, DP-13 and DP-19
area: Agent screening: route, ledger path, raise members and the table a column lives in
owner_role: Solution architect with the P10 service owner and the owners of rwb-source-data, rwb-deviation, rwb-case and rwb-agent
proposed: Reach the panel, feedback and evaluation reads through the gateway-bff route as a pass-through of one hop; read the ledger and the valuation fact through the rwb-source-data contract with one hop and the 2 s budget; state the raise with raisedBy 'SCREENING_AGENT' and the run ID and read back the deviation ID and the decision record entry ID; take the agent_feedback table and the panel and feedback operations from RWB-P10-E2028-APP and add no column and no migration here; keep every legacy value and settle each open string with its owner. The app story builds against the fakes of section 12.8 until each is agreed.

title: The contract slice of the screening evaluation: the gateway-bff route name and path, the member types beyond the names, the score-row members beyond the baseline AgentEvaluation, the page size of the evaluation list and the name of the ledger operation are not fixed by any source
source: Legacy RWB-E2-029 sections 7, 11 and 12; FSD P10 Agent runtime v3 A2.5, A2.7 and A2.8; TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T3.1, T3.2 and T-A.2 (API-P10-006 to API-P10-008); API Specification v4 (AgentEvaluationRequest, AgentEvaluationRun, AgentEvaluation, AgentEvaluationReport, AgentFeedbackRequest, AgentOutput, DeviationRequest); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 15, 16 and 41 to 43; Ownership Map v1 (seven P10 API rows, eight P10 tables, EV-28 and DecisionRecorded EV-08); Template and Rules v1 §R4, §R5.5 and §R9
section: 3 Preconditions; 5 Exception paths; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC7; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.2; 12.3; 12.8
description: Four elements of the contract are open in the sources. (1) The gateway-bff route in front of the seven operations has no name and no path, and DP-19 requires the route for every screen read. (2) The API Specification v4 AgentEvaluation carries approach, labelKey, sampleSize, agreementRate and failureCount only, while the legacy AC1 reads precision, recall and the three counts and TSD P10 T3.1 defines true_positive, false_positive, false_negative, precision_value and recall_value; the five members this key adds to the score row therefore have a table but no answer member. (3) The member types of the report, of the score row and of the policy payload are given as names only, and the page size and cursor of the evaluation list are named by no source. (4) The ledger read the screening proposal depends on has no operation name. The contract keeps the legacy values and states each addition where it appears; it declares no lake artefact and no daily agent table, because no data lake exists and the aggregate belongs to another story.
evidence: API Specification v4 AgentEvaluation (approach, labelKey, sampleSize, agreementRate, failureCount) and AgentEvaluationReport (evaluationId, agent, sampleSize, versions, agreementByLabel[], failureCounts, totalCostThb, costPerCaseThb, latencyP50Ms, latencyP95Ms); TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T3.1 agent_evaluation (DF-AGT-086 to DF-AGT-096, including true_positive, false_positive, false_negative, precision_value and recall_value) and agent_policy (DF-AGT-008 to DF-AGT-018); FSD P10 Agent runtime v3 A2.8 AC-ALT-P10-008-01 ('one score row per code X1 to X7 holds precision, recall and sample size 200 ... precision is 0.9000 and recall is 0.7500'); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 43 row 8 (DecisionRecorded producer all 19, topic rwb.decision-record.v1) and row 28 (AgentRunCompleted, rwb.agent.events.v1); Ownership Map v1 (GET /admin/agent-evaluations, GET /admin/agent-evaluations/{evaluationId}/report and the other five P10 rows owner P10; decision_log_entry owner P7); Template and Rules v1 §R5.5 DP-03, DP-09, DP-11, DP-13, DP-17 (ruling) and DP-19
area: Contract: route, score-row members, member types and the ledger boundary
owner_role: Tech lead of rwb-agent with the solution architect and the owners of rwb-decision, rwb-deviation and rwb-case
proposed: Declare the score row with the five TSD members beside the baseline ones and fix their names in the report; leave the member types and the page size to the review with their owners; declare the route as a pass-through of one hop whose name is agreed with the route contract; name the ledger read as one hop with its window; state the record mapping of a confirmation and a rejection and the one-feedback pair; state that no lake artefact and no daily agent table is declared. The app story and the integration copy build against these shapes and the five fakes.
